policies.title: Chilean ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board table expressly makes a visa available to Chilean nationals on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: The listed visa is obtained on arrival and costs 40 JOD.
Jordan's table says all non-Jordanians must register on Gateway2Jordan before departure for a QR code.
Work, residence, special travel documents, entry-point limits, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Chilean ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The in-force Ukraine–Chile treaty waives visas for Chilean holders of ordinary travel documents for short, non-remunerated visits.
conditions: The treaty permits entry, exit, transit and stays up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
It excludes diplomatic and service passports, immigration, permanent residence and gainful activity.
War-related border operations, work, residence, special documents, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.
